preprocess: archived OpenAI CLIP preprocessing: resize short side to 224 and center crop 224
intervention: add -inf to attention logits at selected patch-key columns in every visual attention block/head, retaining CLS
response_definition: original-minus-masked image feature difference, multiplied by model logit scale and dotted with text features
normalization: divide each held-out aggregate by the L2 norm of the mean held-out class text feature

strategy_definitions.WF: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop - selection max-foil drop
strategy_definitions.Mean: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop - selection mean-foil drop
strategy_definitions.Max-.1: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop - 0.1 * selection max-foil drop

screen: bbox precision >= 0.5 AND normalized held-out foil-mean margin > 0
failure: normalized held-out target drop minus worst non-target foil drop < 0

bootstrap.conditional_rule: jointly resample numerator and denominator before recomputing the ratio

device: PyTorch MPS on MacBook M4 Pro; CPU fallback only for unsupported MPS masked-attention batches
